title: Project API port
responsibility: Define project requests shared by Web and native account clients without owning credentials or transport.

outputs.name: BrowserApi
outputs.description: The request client for reads and writes, with four Promise-returning methods that each take a string path: get<T> and send<T> resolve to a caller-chosen T, media resolves to { bytes: Uint8Array; mediaType: string }, and bytes resolves to a Uint8Array. send accepts only 'POST' or 'DELETE' with an optional unknown body, query values may be string, null or undefined, and these declarations do not check responses against T.

outputs.name: ApiFailure
outputs.description: An Error subtype for a failed API request, carrying a numeric status and a string code that a caller can inspect when a request fails. Nothing in these files constructs or throws an ApiFailure, and the types accept any number for status and any string for code.
